title: Pitchnova 25
subtitle: National Student Pitching Championship
description: Pitchnova was the flagship national student pitching championship of APV E-Cell. Student founders from across 40+ colleges pitched innovative ventures to a jury of angel investors, industry founders, and incubation mentors. The three-day event combined keynotes, mentor pods, and a high-stakes final pitch round with a record-breaking prize pool.
highlights: Pitch Bootcamps with E-Cell IIT Bombay
